correctness.rationale: Complete explicit 5-label word enumeration and A5-orbit classifier establish five chain group ranks and all projected signed incidences. Independent label-wise consistency and d squared zero checks precede exact Smith reductions, giving d4 nonunit invariants 3 and 30. Three color-triple relations kill pi1; simple-connected skeletal Hurewicz and homology Whitehead reduce the top 4-cell attachments to the same Smith matrix, yielding the asserted Moore wedge. Verification output and code are complete and self-contained for this finite case.
